Notes input retires prepared preview and disables download. Preview and buildChecklistHtml render the same accepted prepared model through renderChecklist. Notes enter a separately labelled escaped text context; pre-wrap preserves line breaks and overflow-wrap accommodates long text. Physical6242-byte HTML hash matches the author receipt, which also observes exact note text after offline reopening.
